# NullByte Mod Manager v0.4.8.3

## Self-update validation release

- Shows the installed application version directly on the existing **App updates** sidebar button, so you can confirm a successful in-place upgrade without opening About or adding a new panel.
- Keeps the application-update publishing configuration unchanged when the correct feed URL is already present, avoiding unnecessary modified `app-update-source.json` files in the private development repository.
- Carries forward the Windows install/uninstall support, dedicated external updater, checksum-verified GitHub releases, and verified public-feed publishing/recovery scripts from v0.4.8.2.

**Testing objective:** upgrade an installed v0.4.8.2 application to v0.4.8.3 through its own App updates button. Do not run the v0.4.8.3 installer for this test.
